title: Two Sum
description: You are given an array of integers and a target value. Find the two different positions in the array whose values add up to the target. Each input has exactly one valid answer, and the same element cannot be used twice.
constraints:
2 <= n <= 10^4
-10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4
-2 * 10^4 <= target <= 2 * 10^4
Exactly one valid pair exists.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer n, the size of the array.
Line 2: n space-separated integers.
Line 3: an integer target.
outputFormat: Two 0-based indices separated by a space, the smaller index first.
hints: Checking every pair works, but it gets slow for large n.
For each number, think about which value you would need to find to reach the target.
A hash map lets you check whether you have already seen that value in constant time.

examples.explanation: The same value can appear twice, as long as the positions differ.
